hero.title: Votera
hero.subtitle1: Votera, the official decision-making platform of BOSagora DAO, is a decentralized application that transparently supports the entire process from proposal creation to evaluation, voting, and execution.
hero.subtitle2: - Evaluators review and validate funding-related proposals to determine whether they can proceed to a formal vote.
hero.subtitle3: - Node operators (validators) can submit proposals and participate in the final voting under the one validator = one vote principle.
hero.subtitle4: Through this process, DAO members can take part in fair and open governance driven by collective intelligence.
